text: はしり　すぎて　つかれたから　まけたんだ　おれ

patterns.name: 〜すぎる
patterns.explanation: すぎる added to a verb says it is done too much. はしり　すぎて = 'running too much, and so'.

patterns.name: 〜から (reason)
patterns.explanation: から after a statement gives it as the reason for what follows. つかれたから = 'because I got tired'.

patterns.name: 〜んだ
patterns.explanation: んだ at the end makes the sentence sound like an explanation of what happened. まけたんだ = 'that's why I lost'.
